_meta.note: 解析标度律与 TPMS 指数(勘误后);适用域(validity_domain)是硬约束,越域使用必须降级

gibson_ashby_bending.validity_domain: bending-dominated 开孔点阵, rho_rel 0.01-0.5, 理想节点
gibson_ashby_bending.source: Gibson & Ashby, Cellular Solids, 2nd ed., Cambridge UP, 1997

dfa_octet_stretch.validity_domain: octet-truss, pin-jointed 假设, 立方轴向加载, rho_rel 0.01-0.5

metal_lattices.value: l/d < 5 时解析律偏差可达 300%
metal_lattices.source: Zhong et al., Curr. Opin. Solid State Mater. Sci. 27:101081, 2023, DOI 10.1016/j.cossms.2023.101081
metal_lattices.note: 勘误:期刊为 COSSMS 非 Composite Structures;该数字仅限金属

polymer_lattices.source: 内部工程估计,查无文献出处(2026-06-10 调研);可从 Nasim 2021 / Chen 2023 拟合残差重推导
polymer_lattices.note: 输出必须标 inference 并降级

tpms_stiffness_exponents.validity_domain: 仅 SLM Ti-6Al-4V(Abdulhadi 2023 综述转引,疑似一手 Yan 2015);**不适用 PA12**
tpms_stiffness_exponents.source: Abdulhadi et al., Engineering Reports 5(2):e12566, 2023, DOI 10.1002/eng2.12566(转引);一手疑似 Yan et al. 2015, DOI 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2015.06.024(待核对原文)

pa12_anchor.source: Chen et al. 2023, Materials Advances, DOI 10.1039/D2MA00972B(PA12 TPMS)

pa12_sea_band.validity_domain: PA12 准静态压缩;>8 标 implausible;>10 文献值属金属点阵
pa12_sea_band.source: 内部工程界(组成依据:实测 MJF PA12 octet @rho=0.30 SEA 0.63-0.92 kJ/kg;G-A 能量估算上限 ~6-8;原 HANDOFF 2-15 过乐观已勘误)

maxwell_rule.interpretation: M>=0 stretch 倾向, M<0 bending 倾向;必要非充分,只说倾向不说判定
maxwell_rule.counterexample: FCCZ/FBCCZ 含定向 strut(Nasim & Galvanetto 2021, MJF PA12)
maxwell_rule.source: Maxwell 1864; Deshpande, Ashby & Fleck, Acta Mater. 49(6):1035-1040, 2001, DOI 10.1016/S1359-6454(00)00379-7
